response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing') AS channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions oe2 JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS channel_share FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing') ORDER BY channel;

assumptions.assumption: "channel's share of the total" refers to the channel's share of total execution count, not share of total filled quantity.

alternatives.interpretation: channel's share could mean the share of total filled quantity (sum of fillcount per channel divided by sum of all fillcount), rather than share of execution count
alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing') AS channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, SUM(oe.fillcount) / (SELECT SUM(oe2.fillcount) FROM orderexecutions oe2 JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS channel_share FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing') ORDER BY channel;
